query:
SELECT id FROM scheduled_action
            WHERE enabled
              AND task->>'sdk' IS DISTINCT FROM $1
              AND (
                  jsonb_path_exists(task, '$.steps.** ? (@.type == "code")')
                  OR jsonb_path_exists(task, '$.sub_routines.steps.** ? (@.type == "code")')
              )
              AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR id > $2)
            ORDER BY id
            LIMIT $3
